tasks.playbook:
Work the events in the `# Event` section.

For each one: read it, decide whether it is already handled, and if it is not, do the work it names. One PR is one item — read its description, take the change, open a PR.

When every event is handled, stop. Do not go looking for the rest of the backlog; the cron slot that sweeps it is a separate run.

If the events turn out to need nothing — already fixed, already merged, not yours — write `status.md` with `level: skip` and say so. That is a real answer.
